description: The bar chart illustrates MAP@10 values as a function of the parameter \(m\), showing two color-coded sets of bars corresponding to two sampling strategies (a purple series and a yellow series labeled in the legend as “Uniform Sampling Strategy”). The horizontal axis contains the categories \(m = 6, 7, 8, 9, 10\) (shown twice, once under each color group), labeled “m,” and the vertical axis is labeled “MAP@10” on a linear scale ranging from 23.0 to 27.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. In the left cluster, five purple bars appear at \(m=6\) through \(m=10\) with approximate heights of about 25.9 (m=6), 26.7 (m=7), 26.3 (m=8), 26.5 (m=9), and 26.4 (m=10). In the right cluster, five yellow bars (Uniform Sampling Strategy) appear at \(m=6\) through \(m=10\) with approximate heights of about 24.4 (m=6), 24.8 (m=7), 25.6 (m=8), 25.2 (m=9), and 24.4 (m=10). The bars are presented as two separated groups rather than side-by-side within each \(m\), there is no stacking, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color encoding and the legend.
